description: This file contains C++ source code for a test helper class 'TestWithScope' that sets up build environment, executes code snippets, and manages toolchains for testing purposes within a build system, along with related classes for parsing and target setup.

classes.name: TestWithScope
classes.description: A helper class for setting up and executing build system snippets in tests, managing build settings, toolchains, and scope.

classes.name: TestParseInput
classes.description: A class for parsing input strings into build system tokens and parse trees for testing.

classes.name: TestTarget
classes.description: A test-specific subclass of Target for creating build targets in tests.

methods.name: ParseLabel
methods.description: Resolves a string into a build label within the test scope.

methods.name: ExecuteSnippet
methods.description: Executes a code snippet within the test scope, resolving targets.

methods.name: ExecuteExpression
methods.description: Parses and executes an expression string within the test scope.

methods.name: SetupToolchain
methods.description: Configures a toolchain with various build tools for testing.

methods.name: SetCommandForTool
methods.description: Sets the command pattern for a given build tool.

methods.name: AppendPrintOutput
methods.description: Appends output to the internal print output buffer.
